basic_details.job_title: Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Research Associate, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Pondicherry University is filling one Research Associate-I (RA-I) post and two Project Technical Support III posts. The posts are in the project "CARMA: The Co-selection of Antimicrobial Resistance by Metals Alliance", and each has a tenure of 1 year. The RA-I post pays Rs.58,000/- + 20 % HRA and requires a Ph.D awarded in Microbiology, Genetics, Biotechnology, or any other discipline of Life Sciences as on 1 October 2026. The Project Technical Support III posts pay Rs. 28,000/- + 20 % HRA and require an M.Sc./M.Tech in a listed subject.

how_to_apply: Applications are made by post only. The notice does not describe an application form or an online portal.
Send it by post to: Prof. Joseph Selvin, Department of Microbiology, Pondicherry University, Kalapet, Puducherry – 605014.
Send it on or before 10 November 2026.
The department's letterhead gives these contact details: Tel: 0413-2654865, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the RA-I post, the Ph.D must already be awarded as on 1 October 2026. For the Project Technical Support III posts, the notice also lists under desirable qualification that the candidate should be willing to work in clinical settings as required by the project. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Project Technical Support III posts and 1 Research Associate-I (RA-I) post. The notice does not print a number for the RA-I post, so it is counted as 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Pondicherry University CARMA project posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their updated curriculum vitae by post on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Pondicherry University Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The RA-I post requires a Ph.D Awarded in Microbiology, Genetics, Biotechnology, or any other discipline of Life Sciences as on 1 October 2026. Expertise in antimicrobial resistance and microbial genomics, with strong communication skills and proficiency in data management, is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: The post requires an M.Sc./M.Tech in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Medical Biotechnology, Medical Biochemistry, or any stream of Life Sciences. Experience in handling clinical and environmental samples, along with proficiency in scientific communication and data management, is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Pondicherry University project posts?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I (RA-I) post pays Rs.58,000/- + 20 % HRA. The Project Technical Support III post pays Rs. 28,000/- + 20 % HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your updated curriculum vitae by post to Prof. Joseph Selvin, Department of Microbiology, Pondicherry University, Kalapet, Puducherry – 605014, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of the Pondicherry University CARMA project posts?
faq.answer: Both the Research Associate-I (RA-I) post and the Project Technical Support III posts have a tenure of 1 year. They are project positions under the CARMA: The Co-selection of Antimicrobial Resistance by Metals Alliance project.

faq.question: Q8. Do Project Technical Support III candidates have to work in clinical settings?
faq.answer: Under desirable qualification, the notice says the candidate should be willing to work in clinical settings as required by the project.
